PROTECTED_FIELDS.finding: THE NO-INK CLAIM IS ASSERTED, NOT MEASURED, FOR THIS FAMILY. scripts/build-census-v1-al-felony-nonconviction-90-set.mjs line 851 writes refusedFieldsWithInk: [] and nonWhitespaceGlyphsOutsideMeasuredWriteBoxes: 0 as literals into reports/actual-writes.json. verify-packet-completeness.mjs raises protectedWrites ONLY by iterating that array and visualDefects ONLY when that number exceeds zero, and scripts/rcap-packet-completeness/verify-absent-is-not-zero.test.mjs states the rule the literals defeat: absence of refusedFieldsWithInk is a real zero, not an unmeasured counter. So an empty array typed by the builder is indistinguishable to the verifier from an empty array it measured, and two of the nine counters are laundered from an assertion into a measured zero. Its al-trafficking sibling proves the measurement is available in this state and this form: scripts/build-census-v1-al-trafficking-set.mjs computes refusedFieldsWithInk per box (lines 723-805) and holds two positive controls that fire (lines 1493-1508). Worse, the same line writes flattenedWidgetAppearancesReadFromOutputBytes: packet.writes.length, i.e. 30 — a positive count of flattened widget appearances in bytes that carry NO AcroForm and ZERO widget annotations (measured). The true value is null. Because verify-packet-completeness.mjs counts that field as one of the two real readings that license the invisibleWrites test, a literal 30 would satisfy that test on its own even if the genuine glyph reading were zero. VF41 measured 8 of this family 186 refusals directly (the CR-65 page-5 and page-6 elections, all blank); the other 178 are measured by nothing.

laneFindings.title: The nine counters are bit-for-bit invariant across this repair, on both granted families.
laneFindings.measured: VF41 ran verify-packet-completeness.mjs --family on both granted families at 59b2133a843ffa629b0eb2f6fbd74e4266d1746f, then checked the pre-repair participant-instructions.md and source-receipt.json out of f63d56734^ into the tree and ran it again. Before and after are identical in every respect: al-felony-nonconviction-90-set PASS_COMPLETE 30/216 written with all nine counters zero, mn_petition_609a02_subd3-set PASS_COMPLETE 21/131 written with all nine counters zero. Not merely both-pass — the same verdict, the same written ratio, the same nine zeros. FIX02 claim is CONFIRMED.
laneFindings.meaning: The nine counters cannot distinguish a guide that names a sworn election from one silent about it, nor a guide that orders a participant to fill a blank that does not apply to them from one that conditions it. REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING, as a participant-facing obligation, is invisible to every counter the factory has. The tree was restored to HEAD and verified clean by digest afterwards.

laneFindings.title: The shared anchor-capture reader transposes glyphs within a line, not only mis-decodes ZapfDingbats.
laneFindings.measured: On delivered page 9 of al-felony-nonconviction-90-set canonical.pdf, scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-pdf-anchor-capture.mjs returns "Page 1 of 3 Rev. 5/2042". pdftotext -layout on the same page and the same bytes returns "Page 1 of 3 Rev. 5/2024". The reader has reordered the digits of the form revision date. Separately, and as FIX02 reported, the same reader returns "4STATE OF ALABAMA" where the page prints a ZapfDingbats check mark before STATE OF ALABAMA: ZapfDingbats code 0x34 is a check mark and the reader emits the raw character 4. Both confirmed.
laneFindings.meaning: All four of FIX02 guards compare a quoted string against this reader output with .includes(). A reader that can reorder glyphs can, in principle, assemble a line that is not visually contiguous on the page and report a quotation as printed when it is not. VF41 independently re-located every quoted line with pdftotext and all thirteen are genuinely printed where the guides say, so no current guard pass is wrong. The mechanism is nonetheless unsound and the transposition is a live defect in a reader four builders depend on.

laneFindings.title: The identical filing al-pardoned-felony-set delivers still carries the exact defect FIX02 named as the sworn-page hazard.
laneFindings.measured: Per data/rcap-grade-a/packet-factory-24h/TWO_ALABAMA_ROUTES_ONE_IDENTICAL_FILING.json these two families deliver the same filing. VF41 confirmed the relevant part directly: the page-text sha256 of delivered pages 5 and 6 is identical between al-felony-nonconviction-90-set/fixtures/canonical.pdf and al-pardoned-felony-set/fixtures/canonical.pdf (page 5 7e13ea1e5ce44f98, page 6 f944c8a6198b1164). al-pardoned-felony-set participant-instructions.md has ZERO occurrences of Attached to this Petition are, of Select one of the following, of pro se (Not represented, and of only if you tick — and lists County where any previous expungement was filed and Court case number of any previous expungement UNCONDITIONALLY at lines 43-44.
laneFindings.answerToTheQuestionAsked: FIX02 added guidance is correct for BOTH grounds, not one. Nothing in the new section is ground-specific: the page-5 attachment rule, the page-6 sworn select-one about prior expungement applications, and the pro se box are CR-65 own printed words and apply to any petitioner on that form. That is precisely why the gap matters — the guidance is right for the pardoned-felony participant too, and that participant is not being given it.
laneFindings.notForVF41: Whether two routes should deliver one filing is Roger to settle. This finding is narrower: the repair is correct for both grounds and was applied to only one of the two families that ship it, and none of FIX02 guards reach the other.

laneFindings.title: A refused MN build leaves the fabricated text in the participant-facing guide on disk.
laneFindings.measured: scripts/build-census-v1-mn_petition_609a02_subd3-set.mjs writes participant-instructions.md at line ~2132 and asserts the FEE102 guards immediately after. When VF41 flipped the printed-line guard, the build refused as designed but left participant-instructions.md on disk containing the fabricated Choose both: text; git status showed it modified after a non-zero exit. VF41 restored it.
laneFindings.meaning: The refusal is not atomic. A build that stops for a real cause leaves a participant-facing document rewritten past the point the guard rejected. Nothing downstream distinguishes that file from a completed one.

laneFindings.title: FIX02 repaired the guides, not the field map classification.
laneFindings.measured: All 8 CR-65 page-5/page-6 selection controls in al-felony-nonconviction-90-set production-field-map.json still carry effectiveLabel values of the form "Participant choice: Check Box3.1.0 (selection)" — the raw AcroForm field name wrapped — and requiredBeforeFiling is absent on all 8 rather than false.
laneFindings.meaning: Correct as far as it goes: the guide now names these elections in the form own printed words, which is what reaches the participant. But the classification FIX02 identified as the root cause is unchanged, so any future consumer reading the field map rather than the guide sees the same silence.
